SPORTS AND RECREATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #19
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: SPORTS AND RECREATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. Only the volume
   B. The speed of the music
   C. The ticket price
   D. Only the costume

2. Best practice when working on Ethical issues in Sports and Recreation: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Ethical issues in Sports and Recreation with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Damage equipment used for Ethical issues in Sports and Recreation.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Ethical issues in Sports and Recreation.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Ethical issues in Sports and Recreation.

3. Best practice when working on Injuries in Sports and Recreation ● Management of some common injuries (controll: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Injuries in Sports and Recreation ● Management of some common injuries (controll with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

   C. Refuse all feedback on Injuries in Sports and Recreation ● Management of some common injuries (controll.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Injuries in Sports and Recreation ● Management of some common injuries (controll.

4. Best practice when working on Game officials: (1 mark)

7. Best practice when working on Officiating Games III: (1 mark)

   D. Practise Officiating Games III with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

8. Best practice when working on Team management ● Role of team manager (planning, Communication, Coordination, W: (1 mark)

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Principles of training Specificity Overload and Progression and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
